items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: He joined, he's been with me now about 4 years, 3, going on 4 years.

ctx.x: Sonny Rossi. He's been up here. He used to have a band here years ago like, I don't know if it was the 30's or the 40's. He was the drummer in his own band. He had a Latin band, and played in the Imperial Room. And, he went away after so many years. He wasn't here when I first came. He went to California.
So, when I came in '67, then he came back up here about, I don't know, maybe the 70's. He joined, he's been with me now about 4 years, 3, going on 4 years.
